meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero was in the gradebook before anyone called me, so who decided that, and when?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale? I'm writing that down, and I'll want to know what else you have besides the checker.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
I'm writing down October 15. A different argument in an outline isn't proof of anything, Hale. Which line, and where are the pages, because I'm not taking your word for either.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and an apology for entering it before anyone called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
